4922719.name: Chabad of Burien and Federal Way
4922719.note: lubavitch.com, 30 Dec 2020 ('New Shluchim to Burien, WA'): 'Rabbi Moshe and Devorah Wolff have been appointed to establish a new Chabad center to service the cities of Burien, Federal Way, and the surrounding Seattle suburbs'; they 'visited the area a few times over the last months'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2020-11-11. Earlier note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search for the older centres; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2020-11-11, so it existed by then. Rabbi Moshe and Devorah Wolff 'have been appointed to establish a new Chabad center' for Burien and Federal Way and 'will travel to the Pacific Northwest' (Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 30 Dec 2020, https://crownheights.info/chabad-news/721841/new-shluchim-to-burien-wa/). Director: Moshe Wolff.

4821900.name: Chabad of South Baltimore & University of Maryland Baltimore
4821900.note: Baltimore Jewish Times, 9 Sept 2021 ('You Should Know ... Chana Kaplan'): she and her husband, Rabbi Yaakov Kaplan, 'opened the Chabad of South Baltimore — which also serves the University of Maryland, Baltimore — in July of 2020'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2021-03-25. Its chabad.org listing went up 2021-03-25, so it existed by then. Director: Yaakov Kaplan.

4782624.name: Chabad at Marist and CIA
4782624.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Jan 2021: Chabad on Campus 'welcomed Rabbi Moshe and Chavie Kalmenson as the new Shluchim to The Culinary Institute of America and Marist College'; 'The Kalmenson's will be opening a full-time Chabad House'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2020-07-16, so the centre was listed by then. Medium: 2020 (the listing) with the full-time shluchim announced in January 2021 (lubavitch.com, Sept 2021, still calls them 'new emissaries'). Earlier note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2020-07-16, so it existed by then. Director: Moshe Kalmenson.

5228285.name: Chabad of Macalester-Groveland
5228285.note: Rabbi Tzemach Feller's own LinkedIn profile: 'Chabad of Macalester-Groveland Oct 2021 - Present'; its chabad.org listing went up 2021-09-14; COLlive ('Third-Generation Fellers Warming Up Minnesota'): the Fellers 'recently opened Chabad of Macalester-Groveland'. Medium: a self-reported profile with a same-year listing. Earlier note: No start date found. COLlive (29 Dec 2022): 'Chabad of Macalester-Groveland is Minnesota's newest Chabad House', Rabbi Tzemach and Mushky Feller, for St. Paul's campuses; before it, students came to Lubavitch House in West St. Paul. AJW directory: 1546 Portland Ave. Its chabad.org listing went up Sept 14 2021, so it existed by then.

2922904.name: Jewish Life at VCU
2922904.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2015-04-29, so it existed by then. In July 2024 Rabbi Menachem and Daniela Lessoff moved to Richmond 'to launch Jewish Life at VCU, a new Chabad on Campus center' (Lubavitch.com, 25 Aug 2025, https://www.lubavitch.com/jewish-life-thrives-at-vcu/); the listing is older (2015), so a Chabad at VCU was listed before they came. Director: Menachem Mendel Lessoff. lubavitch.com, 25 Aug 2025 ('Jewish Life Thrives at VCU'): 'in July 2024, Rabbi Menachem and Daniela Lessoff moved to Richmond to launch Jewish Life at VCU — a new Chabad on Campus center'. The listing is from about 2015, so the stated start is years after it and the year is left open (twelve-shetachim.md rule).

1648946.name: Chabad at Johns Hopkins Hospital
1648946.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search for the older centres; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2011-10-17, so it existed by then. Rabbi Zev and Chani Gopin have been 'the face of Chabad at this elite research hospital and university since 2003' (Lubavitch.com, 1 Dec 2016); this hospital listing only went up in 2011. Director: Zev Gopin. lubavitch.com, 1 Dec 2016: 'Rabbi Zev and Chani Gopin are the face of Chabad at this elite research hospital and university since 2003' (Chabad of Johns Hopkins & Central Baltimore, listing 118606, is dated 2003); this hospital listing went up 2011-10-17 and when its own work began is not stated.
